title: Closeout summary: Agent-loop hardening: cut agent ceremony cost without weakening rails
body:
Subject: milestone:bw_work_cc9d864c47c34baa
Status: ready
Priority: high

## Outcome

Audit of two real agent sessions (dump/agent1-orkflow.md, dump/agent 2 workflow.md) showed ~half of all tool calls were Boreal bookkeeping: a self-invalidating sync/doctor loop after every mutation, inconsistent JSON envelopes forcing jq guesswork, workflow refs that fail via bwrk workflows show, and 20k+ lines of repeated JSON per closeout. This milestone stabilizes contracts, removes self-inflicted staleness churn, shrinks output, rewrites workflows around golden-path commands, and locks it all in with transcript-replay regression tests. Enforcement semantics (gates, evidence, verification, summaries, blocked-until-children) do not change.
